text: INTERPRETER + CLI (interp.rs, builtins.rs, main.rs, outcome.rs, env_registry.rs): under a supervisor the outcome nonce arrives on fd 4 (AXON_OUTCOME_NONCE_FD), never in the environment; the interpreter reads and closes it and goes non-dumpable; completion is the record class (exit only from main outside every sandbox_run). AXON_OUTCOME_NONCE is refused (exit 2). Without a supervisor axon run output is byte-identical: not PCI-reviewed
